explication: EDtunnel is a Cloudflare Workers/Pages proxy service. Its principal workflow builds per-request configuration from environment defaults and URL overrides, routes HTTP requests to configuration/subscription responses or WebSocket requests into VLESS/Trojan protocol handling, then forwards traffic through supported proxy transports. The README also documents SOCKS5/HTTP, VLESS outbound, UDP, proxy rotation/failover, and a separate lightweight VLESS snippet implementation. Some links for unsampled modules rely on the SOURCE INDEX or README rather than inspected implementation details.
